metricDefinitions.fps: mean presented-draw rate over the last 240 submitted draws (1000 / mean draw interval)
metricDefinitions.p95Ms: 95th percentile presented draw interval, ms — pacing proxy, not display-arrival proof
metricDefinitions.cpuRenderP95Ms: p95 main-thread cost of render() per submitted draw, ms (excludes compositor/GPU)
metricDefinitions.draws: total presented draws since adapter creation (monotonic counter)
metricDefinitions.fit: applied display-fit result: integer device-px per art px, or nearest fit with CSS world width
metricDefinitions.headlessRafBaseline: rAF cadence of this headless Chromium+SwiftShader environment on about:blank at the same viewport — the environment ceiling, not a game property
